decision_question: How should the inner bench loop proceed after iteration 1?
hypothesis: Paired A/B rounds can resolve the target difference within the available bench slots.
uncertainty: Only two bench positions per round are available and each round costs roughly 30 days.

evidence.statement: Synthetic campaign record recorded for schema validation only; this is not product evidence.

decision_rule: Continue only while stop_state is CONTINUE and the iteration count stays within max_iterations.
result: Iteration 1 completed with stop_state CONTINUE and iteration 2 is opened.
next_action: Run iteration 2 with the A/B pair swapped.

pairing_design.description: Synthetic fixture: A/B pair runs in the same round and is swapped in the next round, so bench-to-bench drift cancels; at a fixed sigma, pairing buys more resolution than measuring sigma precisely.
